title: Update algo Tradingsoftware
author: Significant-Lion5275
selftext:
Hi guys jsut wanted to update you on my september performance of my algo, had problems at first with the roll over, market was really terrible from monday up to now, hope when the rollover is finished it returns to the old performance from the last month, what really sucks it was always really close maybe 1-3 ticks movement to take the order but then returned and later on moved to our TP, which sucks cuz that happened like 3 or 4 times the last couple of days but yk how day trading is righ?! :))

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the one to three tick miss that then runs to your target is worth logging as its own column. if it keeps happening it is not bad luck, it is your limit sitting exactly where everyone else's is, and a tick of give on the entry may cost less than the runs you are missing.
